subject: science
title: REVIEW MIDTERM 1 (PART 2) - ĐỀ THI THỬ GIỮA KÌ
subTitle: Fertilisation, Fruit Formation & Seed Dispersal Methods

cards.vietnamese: Thụ tinh: Phấn + Noãn trong bầu nhụy tạo hạt -> Bầu nhụy phát triển thành quả
cards.definition: Pollen joins egg in ovary to make seeds. Seeds are dispersed by wind, water, animals, or explosion.
cards.example: Dandelions disperse by wind; coconuts by water; berries by animals.

exercises.question: After fertilisation, which part of the flower swells and develops into a fruit containing seeds?
exercises.explanation: Sau khi thụ tinh, bầu nhụy (ovary) phát triển phình to thành quả bảo vệ hạt.

exercises.question: Dandelion seeds have light, parachute-like hairs. How are they dispersed?
exercises.explanation: Hạt bồ công anh có túm lông nhẹ như chiếc dù, phát tán nhờ gió (by wind).
